svg.text: NHIS + financing + the nurse's policy voice

g.text: IN: levies
NHI levy (VAT),
SSNIT share,
premiums
POOL: NHIA
fund + district
schemes +
claims vetting
OUT: benefits
OPD, admissions,
maternity, drugs
on list
EXEMPT (no premium): under-18, 70+, indigents, pregnant women (free maternal), SSNIT
pensioners, LEAP/disability per policy — REGISTER them, don't bill them. Excluded: cosmetic,
optics beyond list, most cancers beyond protocol, VIP extras — explain BEFORE care, bill
transparently. Claims: document → code → vet → pay (delays happen — accurate claims pay
first; PRO-I M5's records are revenue). Fraud (upcoding, ghost patients, drug diversion)
prosecutes — nurses guard the pool.
FINANCING MIX: tax + levies + premiums + donors + out-of-pocket (shrinking it =
UHC). UHC/SDG 3: everyone covered, protected from ruin, quality assured — nurses are
UHC's workforce (most numerous, most rural, most trusted). Cost-conscious care: right test,
right drug (STG generics), no waste — stewardship IS advocacy for the next patient.
POLICY CYCLE: agenda (problem + data + story) → formulate (draft + consult) → adopt
(approve + fund) → implement (train + supply + supervise) → evaluate (did it work? audit!)
→ revise. Nurse's ladder: ward data → facility meeting → district/regional forums → GRNA
+ NMC position papers → MOH consultations → media + MPs (evidence + stories + asks).
GRNA (association: welfare + voice) ≠ NMC (regulator: licence + discipline — PRO-I M1):
join, pay dues, vote, volunteer — associations amplify solo voices into policy. Strikes:
last resort, legal procedure, minimum service for the dying — ethics outlast disputes
(PRO-I M2/M3: abandonment never lawful). Global: WHO, ICN, SDGs — Ghana's nurses
in diaspora + at home shape world health; migration's push/pull debated — serve,
learn, return-or-remit: the brain-drain conversation needs nurse voices most.
Exam line: \"nurses deliver policy at bedsides — and must write it in boardrooms.\"
